name: jev-compact
description: Context compaction that prunes instead of summarising: rules drop exploration output and hook noise locally, Jev ranks the rest against a budget, a note says what was removed, and removed outputs are archived for the brain. Falls back to the built-in summary when it cannot do better.

targetPercent.title: Target context share
targetPercent.description: Prune down to this percentage of the context window (estimated).

compactAtPercent.title: Auto-compact at
compactAtPercent.description: Context percentage at which a finished turn triggers compaction.

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum reduction
minReductionRatio.description: Below this estimated reduction the built-in summary runs instead.

brainArchive.title: Archive pruned outputs
brainArchive.description: Write removed tool outputs to ~/brain/archive/compaction/ for the daily brain sync.
